summary.circadian_impact: SEVERE — only 3 of 24 hour-buckets have data, circadian model is 87.5% blind

gaps.impact: Zero health telemetry for 8 hours before Incident 1. Memory pressure was building during this window but we have no visibility. This is the root cause of Precursor Detection = 0.35.

gaps.impact: The longest continuous gap in the entire dataset. System was effectively silent for 38 hours after Incident 2. No DMN records, no telemetry, no governance events during this window.
gaps.backfill_feasibility: NONE — no source data exists for this window. System was idle/offline.
gaps.recommended_action: Mark as UNKNOWN. Tag the gap boundary. No interpolation possible.

gaps.impact: Only 1 somatic attention snapshot exists in the entire history. Attention dynamics — which are the primary precursor signal — have zero temporal resolution. This single snapshot cannot reveal temporal patterns.
gaps.backfill_feasibility: NONE — attention state was not being captured before the somatic subsystem was built
gaps.recommended_action: Ensure somatic attention snapshots are captured every DMN tick going forward. For historical replay, derive approximate attention from available signals (health scores, incident triggers).

gaps.impact: 33-minute gap early in the timeline. System was likely booting/initializing.
gaps.backfill_feasibility: LOW — system was likely initializing, no meaningful telemetry to interpolate
gaps.recommended_action: Mark as startup gap. Tag with UNKNOWN origin.

gaps.impact: Health scores were NOT regenerated after the initial burst. The health_scores.json 'current' entry stayed frozen at the 2026-05-11T21:57 value for over 2 days.
gaps.backfill_feasibility: PARTIAL — DMN tick telemetry (60s cadence since 2026-05-13) contains raw CPU/memory/disk/load/process metrics that can be used to reconstruct health scores
gaps.recommended_action: Reconstruct health scores from DMN tick telemetry using the health scoring formula

gaps.impact: Circadian baseline only covers hours 13, 21, 22. Hours 0-12 and 14-20 and 23 have zero data. The circadian model cannot distinguish normal from abnormal behavior for 87.5% of the day.
gaps.backfill_feasibility: PARTIAL — DMN tick telemetry from 2026-05-13 onward covers additional hours, can extend baselines
gaps.recommended_action: Extend circadian baselines using post-daemon telemetry from all available hours

gaps.impact: Between two reflex triggers, no continuous monitoring data. The second incident at 22:14 shows memory_used_percent dropped from 99.28% to 97.69% but we don't know the trajectory.
